regions.finding: Four explicitly labelled previous-work transformations; retained as literature context and not counted as current-paper experiments.
Current-work generic CuBr/toluene/100 °C cycloisomerization; recorded as a generic scheme, not a concrete scope row.

All 14 optimization rows were recorded separately. Entry 14 is a true no-reaction control. Entries 2-4 have blank yield/selectivity cells and prose-reported unknown decomposition; entry 5 reports 12% product plus decomposition. Footnote conditions 1a 0.2 mmol, 0.1 M, and 5 mol% catalyst were structured; yields are isolated per footnote b.

Entry 1 supplies an explicit 12 h duration. Separate Z-1a and Z/E-1a-mixture experiments under optimized conditions each give 66% product with reported isomer ratios. Narrative repetitions of table rows were linked rather than duplicated.

unresolved: Only Table 1 entry 1 has an explicit 12 h duration; that duration was not silently inherited by entries 2-14.
The prose-only Z-1a and Z/E-1a experiments do not report reaction scale, time, workup, purification, or yield measurement basis.
Complete structures and absolute configurations require structure-level review or the unprovided SI.
